config.EnableThisMod.name: Enable this mod
config.EnableThisMod.description: On/Off setting of this mod itself.
config.RemoveBuildRestrictions.name: Remove Build Restrictions
config.RemoveBuildRestrictions.descripti: Building is available immediately upon turning on the setting.(Unlocking build)
config.FreeToBuild.name: Free To Build
config.FreeToBuild.description: When the setting is turned on, the cost of building is zero.
config.ImmediateBuildFinish.name: Immediate Build Finish
config.ImmediateBuildFinish.description: Turning on the setting allows building to be finished in a fraction of a second.
config.TransparentWhenGoBehind.name: Transparent When Go Behind
config.TransparentWhenGoBehind.descripti: The tree should be transparent when the character stands behind the building tree.
config.BuildOnTheFloor.name: Build On The Floor
config.BuildOnTheFloor.description: The building can be built on a decorative floor, such as a "wood floor".
config.DisableAction.name: Disable Action
config.DisableAction.description: Disables the text box that appears when you click on a tree, so it no longer responds to clicks.
config.section.ConstructionMenu.name: Show in Build Menu
config.section.ConstructionMenu.descript: This setting determines whether the tree will appear in Robin's build menu. Disabling this setting will prevent the tree from appearing in the menu.
config.Enable_Large.name: Large Tree
config.Enable_Large.description: Displays a "Large Tree" whose appearance changes automatically depending on the season.
config.Enable_Large_Replica.name: Large Tree Replica
config.Enable_Large_Replica.description: It displays a replica "Large Tree" whose appearance does not change with the seasons.

Tree_Description: They will grace your farm with their seasonal appearance.
Replica_Tree_Description: Replica tree. The seasons don't change the way we look...
Mail_Title: Announcement of the start of the tree-planting
Mail_Text: Dear @^^I've been studying tree-planting techniques for a while now, and I've improved enough that it's about time I did it as a job, so next time you ask!^Maybe some real trees and replica trees to spruce up the look of the farm!^^-Robin
Dialogue: Take care of the trees you plant.^(When removing it, go to Robin's Build menu)
